name: Settlement Instruction 19
definition: Provides further details on the settlement of the instruction.

RequestedSettlementDate.name: Requested Settlement Date
RequestedSettlementDate.definition: Date at which the message sender or ChargesRequestor where this element is present expects to be credited for the payment of the charges.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent to which a credit entry will be made as a result of the payment transaction.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Financial institution that receives an amount of money from the financial institutional debtor.||Usage: where used this party must be the same as the message sender or ChargesRequestor where this element is present.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.||Usage: where used this account should be owned by the message sender or ChargesRequestor where this element is present.
